verdict.rationale: Recurring or scheduled jobs, such as periodic crawls, monitoring, or repeated research runs, are a plausible capability for a web-data API platform like Tavily, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only on-demand search, extract, crawl, map and research calls, plus async research task retrieval and streaming. None of it shows any scheduling, cron or recurring-workflow feature; async request IDs and SDK clients are developer building blocks, not scheduling.
